newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 CONTINUES TO REBOUND AT PRICE FIXING.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 CONTINUES TO REBOUND AT PRICE FIXING.

text.p: Czech major issues continued to surge at Tuesday's price fixing on the Prague bourse pushing the PX50 index up 1.24 percent to 515.8.

The upturn was led once again by the index's most heavily capitalised share, SPT Telecom which rose 94 crowns, or 2.9 percent, to 3,244. Power utility CEZ also posted healthy gains rising 23 crowns, 2.4 percent, to 975.
Dealers had predicted further gains, at least in the short term, saying major issues had again become attractively priced, especially to foreign investors, after a long period of sustained losses.
Smaller issues shared in the gains with advancers outpacing decliners by 31 to 12 on the index as a whole.
On the RPIX index of continuously traded shares, investment funds were mixed. RIF rose 16 crowns to 916, Komercni IF was unchanged on 534 and SPIF Cesky was up one crown to 348.
